description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller that handles global errors, intercepting requests to /error and returning a JSON payload with error details such as timestamp, status code, error message, and request path. It is designed to prevent the default white-label error page and provide consistent JSON error responses.

classes.name: GlobalErrorController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller implementing ErrorController, responsible for handling all errors routed to /error and returning JSON formatted error details.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles error requests to /error by constructing a JSON response with timestamp, HTTP status, error message, and request URI, based on attributes from the HttpServletRequest.
